definition: A vertical boundary is described by an offset from a reference surface, object, or plane.
A vertical boundary is expressed as an absolute height in a declared vertical CRS or datum.
A vertical boundary is defined by a title, statute, Crown Grant, strata statement, or approved jurisdictional rule.
A vertical boundary is defined directly by reference to a surface, plane, or other boundary geometry.
The cadastral boundary is established by a defined relationship to a particular building surface, plane or element.
